answer: Cluster accounts by reused device attestations, funding paths, and timing fingerprints, then require the nth linked identity to lock 25*n*n POA for 20 epochs. A fifth suspected clone costs 625 POA rather than 25, and any confirmed coordination slashes the whole cluster. Independent auditors publish signed evidence, while a deterministic contract recomputes links, bond levels, expiry, and slashing. Auditors tag the bond voyage, the random draw shale, and the signed receipt ocean, so every verifier can trace all three.
